FL-2027-SB36.title: Relief of Krystle Mace and Leonard Mace by Charlotte County
FL-2027-SB36.summary: Relief of Krystle Mace and Leonard Mace by Charlotte County; Providing for the relief of Krystle Mace and Leonard Mace by Charlotte County; providing for an appropriation to compensate Mrs. and Mr. Mace for injuries sustained as a result of the negligence of Charlotte County; providing a limitation on compensation and the payment of attorney fees, etc. CLAIM: $6,080,263
FL-2027-SB36.policyArea: general relief bills and local relief bills (claims bills)
FL-2027-SB36.aiSummary: Would provide money to compensate Krystle Mace and Leonard Mace for injuries they say were caused by Charlotte County's negligence. It also sets limits on the compensation and on attorney fees. The claim amount is $6,080,263.

FL-2027-SB22.title: Relief of Michael Barnett by the Department of Children and Families
FL-2027-SB22.summary: Relief of Michael Barnett by the Department of Children and Families; Providing for the relief of Michael Barnett, individually and as the natural parent and legal guardian of R.B.; providing an appropriation to compensate them for injuries and damages sustained as a result of the negligence of the Department of Children and Families; providing a limitation on compensation and the payment of attorney fees, etc. CLAIM WITH APPROPRIATION: $296,400
FL-2027-SB22.policyArea: general relief bills and local relief bills (claims bills)
FL-2027-SB22.aiSummary: This bill would provide relief to Michael Barnett, both for himself and as the parent and guardian of R.B. It would set aside $296,400 to pay for injuries and damages linked to the Department of Children and Families. It would also set limits on the amount paid and on attorney fees.
